verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at kling.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It carries substantive agent-oriented content: REST API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey auth, global and China API endpoints, model capabilities, per-unit pricing, plan details and notes on third-party provider naming. An agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of a fuller companion (e.g. llms-full.txt or markdown API reference pages) giving endpoint-level request/response detail for agents.
